dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

I have lived with dogs in my previous home.

I can be slow to adjust to new environments. I prefer to take things at my own pace.

I would appreciate slow introductions to new people and places to help me feel safe.

I have lived with cats in my previous home.

My foster writes: Meet Clue, a cuddly velcro dog looking for a home to call her own. She's a great loose leash walker and very dog friendly, greeting other dogs with a wagging tail. She loves a good sniff around the neighborhood. Clue is fully house-trained and knows basic commands like sit and stay. Clue is happiest when she's curled up in your lap - a true lover girl.

My Boroughbreaker writes: Clue is as easy going as they come. If she got a report
card it would say she was a pleasure to have in class. She walked beautifully on a leash and did not bark a single time while we walked the entirety of Central Park. She was a little reserved but happy to be pet, as soon as we settled in at a coffee show she plopped down and showed her belly.

A Volunteer Wrote: Never have we wanted someone to get a clue more...specifically THIS Clue. She's a dream on four legs! She's lived sweetly with dogs and children, she's a perfection on a leash , she's affectionate, she takes treats gently, she's happy to hang out in her walker's lap or at her feet (although she's absolutely happiest throwing herself on her back for a belly rub.) We are ALL enchanted by her kindness and resilience and she's been here way too long when she should be lighting up your home with her love! Please, won't you come meet this wondrous dog and let the rest of her life begin?
dog.name: Clue
